blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will have to shell out more for gasoline beginning Tuesday as oil companies prepare to implement a price increase of up to P3.50 per liter. The Department of Energy (DOE) announced the expected hike on Monday. Diesel and kerosene, meanwhile, will have price cuts of at least P1 to P1.90 per liter, […]...
